categories.name: Melatonin
why: Highest-scored product in the brand's range, at about ₹5 a tablet.
Competitors in this set cost two to four times as much per serving.

categories.name: Magnesium glycinate
why: Limitless Labs scores it 9.3/10 on the label: right form, full dose, low price.
Unbox Health's lab test of its 120-capsule glycinate gave a B (now expired); every other glycinate tested got A+.

categories.name: Vitamin D3
categories.alternative: Tata 1mg D3 + K2 if you want both in one tablet
why: Strong, cheap high-dose D3. Good for correcting a deficiency.
It has no K2. Many people pair D3 with K2 (MK-7); Tata 1mg's combo is the cheapest trusted one here.

categories.name: Ashwagandha
why: Uses the clinically studied KSM-66 extract at the studied 600 mg dose.
MuscleBlaze Koshaveda and Tata 1mg Tejasya score a little higher but cost more per serving.

competitors.note: Only 11 mg withanolides vs 25 mg in Rasayanam

categories.name: Vitamin B12
why: Uses methylcobalamin, the active form, at 1,500 mcg.
Avoid the 90-tab pack: ₹44.93 a serving for the same dose.

categories.name: Multivitamin (men)
categories.pick: Multivitamin Tablet for Men Gym (180 tabs)
categories.alternative: GNC Mega Men or MuscleBlaze MB-Vite for fuller dosing
why: Cheapest per day here and beats TrueBasics Multivit on score (6.6 vs 4.6).
Only 7 of 13 key ingredients are at clinical doses; vitamin D and K are short.

categories.name: Creatine
why: Cheapest creatine in the set at ₹3.38 a serving.
No third-party purity certification, and fake supplements are a real problem in India.

categories.name: ZMA (zinc + magnesium)
why: Lab verified, with a strong 440 mg magnesium dose.
Zinc (17 mg) and B6 (2.4 mg) are below standard ZMA doses.

categories.name: Plant protein
categories.alternative: The Whole Truth or OZiva for a cleaner label

link.label: Plant proteins are ranked on the whey page too

why: The pea isolate gives 30 g protein for ₹26.96, under Nutrabox soy isolate at ₹35.
Cleaner labels and better taste cost two to three times as much.

categories.name: Omega-3 fish oil
categories.alternative: TrueBasics Triple Strength (900 mg EPA+DHA, IFOS 5★)
why: All three of the brand's fish oils give about 300 mg EPA+DHA, under the 500–1,000 mg a day usually studied.
TrueBasics Triple Strength gives 900 mg per capsule and is IFOS certified.

categories.name: Collagen
categories.alternative: AS-IT-IS plain hydrolysed collagen, plus vitamin C separately
why: Most of the range is underdosed: a tablet has 1,800 mg against 2.5–10 g a day in studies.
Avoid the Marine Collagen Citrus Burst outright (4.8/10).

competitors.note: Plant precursors + vitamin C, no collagen
